scripts.build: npm run build:building && node scripts/run-hugo.js --gc --minify --cleanDestinationDir && npm run pdf
scripts.build:local: npm run build:building && node scripts/run-hugo.js --gc --minify --cleanDestinationDir && npm run pdf
scripts.check: npm run check:blog-assets && (npm run build || npm run build:local) && npm run check:site-metadata && npm run check:generated-html && npm run check:cv-print && npm run check:links
scripts.serve: npm run build:building && node scripts/run-hugo.js server --renderToMemory
scripts.serve:local: npm run build:building && node scripts/run-hugo.js server --renderToMemory
